--- /workspace/embed_bug.py
+++ /workspace/embed_bug.py
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+embed_bug.py
@@ -1,0 +5,122 @@
+Embed a text payload into a JPEG image's EXIF UserComment field (tag 37510).
+
+Usage:
+  embed_bug.py -i input.jpg -p "payload text" [-o output.jpg]
+  embed_bug.py -i input.jpg -p @/path/to/payload.txt  # read payload from file
+
+Notes:
+- The script writes the EXIF UserComment tag with an 8-byte charset prefix (ASCII with NULs),
+  followed by the payload bytes encoded as UTF-8.
+- If -o is omitted the input file will be overwritten atomically.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+
+try:
+    from PIL import Image
+except ImportError:
+    print("Pillow is required. Install with: pip install pillow", file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(2)
+
+
+def read_payload(spec: str) -> str:
+    """Read payload from a literal string or from a file when spec starts with '@'."""
+    if spec.startswith("@"):
+        path = spec[1:]
+        with open(path, "rb") as f:
+            data = f.read()
+        # attempt utf-8 decode, fall back to latin-1 to preserve bytes
+        try:
+            return data.decode("utf-8")
+        except Exception:
+            return data.decode("latin-1")
+    else:
+        return spec
+
+
+def embed_user_comment(infile: str, payload: str, outfile: str) -> None:
+    """Embed payload into infile's EXIF UserComment and write to outfile."""
+    # Ensure file exists
+    if not os.path.exists(infile):
+        raise FileNotFoundError(infile)
+
+    # Open image
+    img = Image.open(infile)
+    # Get or create EXIF
+    exif = img.getexif()
+    # On some Pillow versions getexif() returns an Exif object; when None, create a new one
+    if exif is None:
+        try:
+            exif = Image.Exif()
+        except Exception:
+            # As a fallback, use an empty dict-like object (older Pillow versions might differ)
+            exif = {}
+
+    # EXIF tag for UserComment
+    USER_COMMENT_TAG = 37510
+
+    # Prepare payload bytes. EXIF UserComment typically expects an 8-byte charset code prefix.
+    try:
+        payload_bytes = payload.encode("utf-8")
+    except Exception:
+        payload_bytes = str(payload).encode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+
+    # Use ASCII charset prefix (8 bytes: 'ASCII' + 3 NULs). Many tools accept this form.
+    prefix = b"ASCII\x00\x00\x00"
+    comment_value = prefix + payload_bytes
+
+    # Attach to EXIF
+    exif[USER_COMMENT_TAG] = comment_value
+
+    # Convert to bytes and save
+    try:
+        exif_bytes = exif.tobytes()
+        img.save(outfile, exif=exif_bytes)
+    except AttributeError:
+        # Some Pillow versions may not support Exif.tobytes() on dict-like exif objects;
+        # try saving without explicit exif (best-effort fallback)
+        img.save(outfile)
+        print("Warning: couldn't write EXIF via Pillow in this environment; saved image without EXIF.",
+              file=sys.stderr)
+        return
+
+    print(f"Wrote UserComment ({len(payload_bytes)} bytes) to {outfile}")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Embed text into JPEG EXIF UserComment")
+    p.add_argument("-i", "--input", required=True, help="Input JPEG file")
+    p.add_argument("-p", "--payload", required=True, help='Payload string or @/path/to/file to read from')
+    p.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output JPEG file (defaults to input, which will be overwritten)")
+    args = p.parse_args()
+
+    infile = args.input
+    outfile = args.output or args.input
+
+    if not infile.lower().endswith((".jpg", ".jpeg")):
+        print("Warning: input file does not have .jpg/.jpeg extension", file=sys.stderr)
+
+    payload = read_payload(args.payload)
+
+    # If overwriting, write to temp file then replace atomically
+    if os.path.abspath(outfile) == os.path.abspath(infile):
+        tmp = infile + ".embed_tmp"
+        try:
+            embed_user_comment(infile, payload, tmp)
+            os.replace(tmp, infile)
+        except Exception:
+            # Clean up temp file on error
+            try:
+                if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                    os.remove(tmp)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            raise
+    else:
+        embed_user_comment(infile, payload, outfile)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
